discover() in prose_style.py walks the filesystem with os.walk and has no gitignore awareness, so --write-baseline bakes any developer's gitignored/untracked files into the committed shrink-only baseline (hit live: 6 entries from .claude/hooks/context/state/*-precompact-facts.md, gitignored with '*', froze locally then reded CI with 6 baselined findings no longer fire).
